chunks: And he, peace be upon him and his family, said:
If any of you intends a need, then let him go to it early, for I asked my Lord, Mighty and Majestic, to bless my Ummah in its early mornings.

key_terms.الْحَاجَةَ: a need, aim, or matter a person seeks to fulfill
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; a direct supplication or request
key_terms.فَلْيُبَكِّرْ: let him go early; let him begin in the early morning
key_terms.يُبَارِكَ: to place blessing and increase in goodness

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about seeking one’s needs early in the morning?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages beginning one’s needs and pursuits early in the morning. It teaches that the early part of the day carries divine barakah for the Ummah, based on the supplication of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم.
